<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

#43350 fixed the MI3XX all-NaN decode by gating the MiniMax-H3 VAE fused norms to NVIDIA, and noted: "Re-enabling the fused path on ROCm needs a separate root-cause fix on AMD hardware." This PR fixes that.

`numerics.mul_rn_f32` is `tl.inline_asm_elementwise` with PTX. On ROCm it fails register allocation: 
```
error: couldn't allocate output register for constraint 'f'
```
and the kernel yields NaN. 

Both call sites #43350 gated (`vae_vit._fused_blocks_available`, `attention._try_fused_qk_rmsnorm_rope`) live in `h3_vae_fused_norm.py`, whose only PTX dependency is `mul_rn_f32`, everything else uses portable `tl.rsqrt`. 
So fixing that one helper restores the entire surface #43350 had to disable.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
- numerics.py: mul_rn_f32 gets a ROCm branch. `v_mul_f32` with a VGPR (=v,v,v) constraint. `v_mul_f32` is RNE like `mul.rn.f32` and equally refuses FMA contraction. The CUDA branch is byte-identical, so NVIDIA behaviour remains unchanged.
- The two current_platform.is_cuda() gates become is_cuda() or is_rocm(). Other platforms keep the unfused fp32-norm path


## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

8×MI355X (gfx950), `test_minimax_h3_vae_parallel_modes.py`: 13 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed. `test_fused_decoder_matches_unfused_forward`, the case that produced 100% NaN mismatch and that #43350 had to make NVIDIA-only, passes on ROCm. 

#### Before

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/980142bf-6d80-47a9-9b49-8a980c0b6d09

#### After
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/de3ad079-32db-4c34-87af-2086d984f214



## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

MiniMax-H3 T2VA, 8×MI355X, 1344×768, 124 frames, 50 steps, seed 42, eager, quality=lossless. Same build, back-to-back, no other GPU tenants:

#### 1. High-level Summary
| Metric | Baseline | New | Diff | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **E2E Latency** | 29691.49 ms | 29465.55 ms | **-225.94 ms (-0.8%)** | ⚪️ |
| **Throughput** | 0.03 req/s | 0.03 req/s | - | - |


#### 2. Stage Breakdown
| Stage Name | Baseline (ms) | New (ms) | Diff (ms) | Diff (%) | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| InputValidationStage | 0.03 | 0.03 | -0.00 | -5.5% | ⚪️ |
| MiniMaxH3PartitionAdmissionStage | 0.02 | 0.02 | +0.00 | +2.3% | ⚪️ |
| MiniMaxH3TextEncodingStage | 1.55 | 1.07 | -0.48 | -31.3% | ⚪️ |
| MiniMaxH3VisualEncodingStage | 0.01 | 0.01 | -0.00 | -6.1% | ⚪️ |
| MiniMaxH3AudioEncodingStage | 0.01 | 0.01 | +0.00 | +1.7% | ⚪️ |
| MiniMaxH3LatentPreparationStage | 13.73 | 12.00 | -1.73 | -12.6% | ⚪️ |
| MiniMaxH3TimestepPreparationStage | 0.17 | 0.17 | +0.01 | +3.1% | ⚪️ |
| MiniMaxH3DenoisingStage | 24786.16 | 24850.55 | +64.39 | +0.3% | ⚪️ |
| MiniMaxH3DecodingStage | 1884.97 | 1683.79 | -201.18 | -10.7% | 🟢 |
| Scheduler.return_result.spill_arrays | 0.06 | 0.06 | -0.00 | -3.5% | ⚪️ |
| Scheduler.return_result.spill_cuda | 0.06 | 0.06 | +0.00 | +3.3% | ⚪️ |
| SchedulerClient.materialize_file_refs | 0.01 | 0.01 | -0.00 | -0.8% | ⚪️ |


While the gain in e2e is marginal, there's clear gain in the decoding stage, as expected. 10.7% faster decod step.
